_comment: Worked example: the DynaClinic demo page. Fields ending in _html are inserted as HTML; others are escaped.
title: DynaClinic in 3D: runbook demo
subtitle: One continuous recording of the runbook, step by step, in the three.js office. Three real cases on OpenAI gpt-6-luna: the Meta-Controller keeps one Primary Care Agent for a simple case, calls the Integrated Care Team for a complex one, and switches to the adversarial Clinical Critic when the specialists disagree. Captions name the runbook step and quote the run's own output. Idle stretches longer than 2.5 s are shortened; nothing else is cut or staged.
video_note: Recorded 2026-10-27 at commit 8f27bff, fresh browser profile, backend on :6400, office on :3100. Click any step in the list to jump there.
